x-m-m3-01.title: Test the claim "multiplying irrational numbers always give irrational number"
x-m-m3-01.goal: Use counterexample to test claim "multiplying irrational numbers always gives irrational number," explain how example supporting am different from counterexample, and fix the claim.
x-m-m3-01.material: For class, one student claim, "If you multiply irrational number by irrational number, answer always irrational!" For example, √2 irrational, √3 irrational too, and their product √6 irrational too. (Read √ as "root.")

x-m-m3-01.s.s1.prompt: Make 2 different examples wey show claim wrong. Choose two irrational numbers √a and √b (a and b natural numbers from 2 to 200), where product √a×√b na rational number (here, natural number).

x-m-m3-01.s.s1.fail.c2: a or b na perfect square, so square root na natural number. Both gats be irrational.

x-m-m3-01.s.s1.fail.c3: Product √a×√b no be natural number. What kind of a×b make root sign disappear?
x-m-m3-01.s.s1.explain: For example, √2×√8=√16=4 and √3×√12=√36=6. Both numbers irrational but product natural number, so claim say product of irrational numbers always irrational wrong. (Multiplying same number, like √2×√2=2 with a=b=2, also be counterexample.)

x-m-m3-01.s.s2.o.c: Dem never prove say √6 really irrational, so dem no fit use this argument as evidence.
x-m-m3-01.s.s2.r.c: 6 no be perfect square, so √6 really irrational. The weakness dey somewhere else.
x-m-m3-01.s.s2.o.d: √2 × √3 fit change into fraction before multiplying, so rational, and this argument wrong.
x-m-m3-01.s.s2.r.d: √2 and √3 na irrational numbers wey no fit write as fractions. Their product √6 too be irrational.
x-m-m3-01.s.s2.explain: Claim "e always happen" no fit confirm by giving plenty examples where e happen; one example where e no happen go disprove am straight away. True say √2 × √3 = √6 (irrational), but counterexample √2 × √8 = 4 still dey.

x-m-m3-07.s.s2.r.d: E true say e open upward. This fact no connect to wrong minimum value.
x-m-m3-07.s.s2.explain: If original expression and solution expression same function, values gats be equal for any x. At x=0 dem be 3 and 11; at x=2 na -5 and 3, so expressions different functions. Checks wey only look x-coordinate or opening direction miss this error.
